title: RotorCalculator
shortDescription: Analyze rotor geometry, operating conditions, performance, and parameter sweeps.
fullDescription:
RotorCalculator is an engineering tool for rotor performance analysis using blade element theory and momentum inflow closure.

Define a rotor, set its operating condition, and inspect dimensional results and aerodynamic coefficients in a consistent quantity / value / unit layout. Contextual help explains technical symbols, models, units, and sign conventions directly in the app.

GEOMETRY
• Factory rotor presets and custom rotor profiles
• Direct editing, save, copy, and delete
• Derived solidity, aspect ratio, areas, taper, and twist
• Airfoil parameters, tip-loss models, and compressibility correction
• Geometry import and export through the Android file picker

CONDITIONS
• Horizontal flow represented by advance ratio μ or speed Vx
• Axial flow represented by α, Vz, or μz
• Six operating input pairs using RPM, collective, thrust, and CT
• Selectable inflow models and induced-power factor
• Numerical Vectorial profile drag

RESULTS AND SWEEPS
• Thrust, torque, power, aerodynamic coefficients, and operating solution
• SI and Imperial presentation with selectable precision
• Parameter sweeps, curve families, custom values, and hover trim control
• Data tables and CSV / PNG export

Calculations run locally. No account is required. Light and Dark themes support phones, tablets, and landscape layouts.

RotorCalculator supports engineering analysis within the assumptions of its models. Results should be checked against appropriate reference data for the intended application; the app is not a flight-control or certification tool.
